name: cg_coin_list
description:
Every coin CoinGecko tracks (coins/list), to map names and symbols to CoinGecko ids.
Returns {coins: [{id, symbol, name}, ...]}: a very large list (tens of thousands of entries); symbols are not unique.
Inputs: none.
To find one coin's id, cg_search is smaller and ranked.
Example: {}
